#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Regenerate assets/factory_banks from owner-Mac KORG Gadget packs (private/dev)."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, json, pathlib, re, struct, sys

CHI_LIB = pathlib.Path("/Library/Application Support/KORG/Gadget/Plug-Ins/ChicagoLibrary.bundle/Contents/Resources")
MIA_LIB = pathlib.Path("/Library/Application Support/KORG/Gadget/Plug-Ins/MiamiLibrary.bundle/Contents/Resources")

def pchk(path: pathlib.Path) -> bytes:
    data = path.read_bytes(); pos = 12
    while pos + 8 <= len(data):
        cid = data[pos:pos+4]; csz = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, pos+4)[0]
        if cid == b"PCHK": return data[pos+8:pos+8+csz]
        pos += 8 + csz + (csz & 1)
    raise RuntimeError(f"no PCHK in {path}")

def all_padded(payload: bytes, nparams: int, search_tail: int = 5000):
    stride = 12; out = []
    for start in range(max(0, len(payload)-search_tail), len(payload)-(nparams-1)*stride-4):
        ok = True; vals = []
        for i in range(nparams):
            off = start + i*stride
            v = struct.unpack_from("<f", payload, off)[0]
            if not (0.0 <= v <= 1.0): ok = False; break
            if i < nparams-1 and payload[off+4:off+12] != b"\x00"*8: ok = False; break
            vals.append(float(v))
        if ok and len({round(v,5) for v in vals}) >= max(3, nparams//6):
            out.append((start, vals, len(payload)-start))
    return out

def extract_factory2(path: pathlib.Path, nparams: int = 22):
    b = path.read_bytes(); out = []; i = 0
    while True:
        o = 32 + i*488
        if o + 220 + (nparams-1)*12 + 4 > len(b): break
        name = b[o:o+40].split(b"\0",1)[0].decode("ascii","ignore").strip()
        if not name or not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9]", name): break
        vals = [float(struct.unpack_from("<f", b, o+220+j*12)[0]) for j in range(nparams)]
        out.append({"name": name, "params": vals}); i += 1
    return out

def pick_min_fe(nks: pathlib.Path, nparams: int, lo: int, hi: int):
    cands = all_padded(pchk(nks), nparams)
    win = [(fe, vals) for _, vals, fe in cands if lo <= fe <= hi] or [(fe, vals) for _, vals, fe in cands if fe <= hi+100]
    if not win: return None
    fe, vals = min(win, key=lambda x: x[0])
    return {"name": nks.stem, "params": vals, "source": "nks-minfe", "from_end": fe}

def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("--out", type=pathlib.Path, default=pathlib.Path("assets/factory_banks"))
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not CHI_LIB.is_dir() or not MIA_LIB.is_dir():
        print("Gadget library packs not found on this Mac", file=sys.stderr); return 2
    chi_macro = json.loads((CHI_LIB/"Chicago/macro_desc.json").read_text())
    mia_macro = json.loads((MIA_LIB/"Miami/macro_desc.json").read_text())
    f2map = {p["name"].rstrip(): p for p in extract_factory2(CHI_LIB/"Factory2.prog")}
    chicago = []
    for nks in sorted((CHI_LIB/"NKS/Presets").glob("*.nksf")):
        if nks.stem in f2map:
            chicago.append({"name": nks.stem, "params": f2map[nks.stem]["params"], "source": "factory2"})
        else:
            got = pick_min_fe(nks, 22, 297, 355)
            if not got: print(f"chicago miss {nks.stem}", file=sys.stderr); return 3
            chicago.append(got)
    miami = []
    for nks in sorted((MIA_LIB/"NKS/Presets").glob("*.nksf")):
        got = pick_min_fe(nks, 18, 250, 400)
        if not got: print(f"miami miss {nks.stem}", file=sys.stderr); return 3
        miami.append(got)
    note = "Owner-paid personal-use packs. Private/dev factory path. Owner strips before public redistribution. No strip automation."
    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    def bank(brand, label, framing, au, macro, presets):
        return {"brand": brand, "label": label, "framing": framing, "au_component": au,
                "parameter_names": [p[1] for p in macro["parameters"]],
                "parameter_defaults": [float(p[2]) for p in macro["parameters"]],
                "count": len(presets),
                "presets": [{"name": p["name"], "params": [round(v,8) for v in p["params"]], "source": p["source"]} for p in presets],
                "license_note": note}
    chi_doc = bank("chicago", "Chicago (Acid)", "faithful-303 factory bank", "KORG: Chicago (Acid) 3.1.6", chi_macro, chicago)
    mia_doc = bank("miami", "Miami (Wobble)", "faithful-303 factory bank (separate from WBL1)", "KORG: Miami (Wobble) 3.1.6", mia_macro, miami)
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1,
        "framing": "faithful-303 factory banks (Chicago Acid / Miami Wobble); not an upgrade brand; WBL1 != Miami factory bank",
        "license_note": note, "user_import_allowed": True, "factory_by_default": True,
        "chicago_count": len(chicago), "miami_count": len(miami),
        "sources": {"chicago_factory2": str(CHI_LIB/"Factory2.prog"), "chicago_nks": str(CHI_LIB/"NKS/Presets"),
                    "miami_nks": str(MIA_LIB/"NKS/Presets"),
                    "chicago_au": "/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Chicago.component 3.1.6",
                    "miami_au": "/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Miami.component 3.1.6"}}
    (args.out/"chicago.json").write_text(json.dumps(chi_doc, indent=2)+"\n")
    (args.out/"miami.json").write_text(json.dumps(mia_doc, indent=2)+"\n")
    (args.out/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+"\n")
    print(f"chicago={len(chicago)} miami={len(miami)} -> {args.out}"); return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Catalog identity comes from package bytes, not from a file name."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
import dev_validate  # noqa: E402
import validation_inputs  # noqa: E402
from firmware_build_labels import inspect_package, version_of_product  # noqa: E402
from fm1pkg_make import ufw  # noqa: E402
from publish_nightly import (LABEL, NightlyPublishError, _embedded_version, _model_entry_ok,  # noqa: E402
                             _version_ok, publish_valid_nightly)
from release_alloc import ReleaseError, bind_file, empty_ledger  # noqa: E402


def git(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], text=True).strip()


def make_pkg(product):
    return ufw(b"\x00" * 1024, b"FELUCCA-LOADER-1" + b"\x00" * 128, product)


def grant(repo, version, commit=None):
    """Place one allocated number for this repo's real commit and Git tree."""
    commit = commit or git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = git(repo, "rev-parse", commit + "^{tree}")
    path = repo / "releases" / "openbeta" / "ledger.json"
    ledger = empty_ledger()
    if path.is_file():
        ledger = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not any(item.get("version") == version for item in ledger["allocations"]):
        major, minor, patch = (int(part) for part in version.split("."))
        ledger["allocations"].append({
            "version": version, "major": major, "minor": minor, "patch": patch,
            "display": version + "_openbeta", "source_commit": commit, "source_tree": tree,
            "immutable": False, "models": {},
        })
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def bind_models(repo, version, elite, pro):
    path = repo / "releases" / "openbeta" / "ledger.json"
    bind_file(path, version, "elite", dev_validate.digest(elite), "ab" * 32, 128)
    bind_file(path, version, "pro", dev_validate.digest(pro), "cd" * 32, 256)
    return path


def write_record(repo, model, fwsc, directory, version=None):
    directory.mkdir()
    commit = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = dev_validate.tree(repo, commit)
    plan = {"base": commit, "scope": "fixture behavior",
            "checks": [{"reason": "changed fixture", "argv": [sys.executable, "test.py"]}]}
    build_log = "app code area 100 B, 40 B free\nRAM .data+.bss 40 B of 100; pool 100 B of 10000\n"
    (directory / "build.log").write_text(build_log)
    (directory / "check-0.log").write_text("affected test passed\n")
    inputs = {
        "schema": validation_inputs.SCHEMA,
        "mode": "dev",
        "source": tree,
        "configuration": {
            "model": model, "config": "dev", "controller": False,
            "plan": plan, "dependencies": [],
        },
    }
    data = {
        "schema": 2,
        "result": "DEV CHECKED",
        "config": "dev",
        "model": model,
        "commit": commit,
        "tree": tree,
        "plan": plan,
        "controller": False,
        "budgets": dev_validate.budgets(build_log),
        "logs": {
            "build": {"returncode": 0, "sha256": dev_validate.digest(directory / "build.log")},
            "check-0": {"returncode": 0, "sha256": dev_validate.digest(directory / "check-0.log")},
        },
        "artifacts": {"package": {"file": Path(fwsc).name, "sha256": dev_validate.digest(fwsc)}},
    }
    if version is not None:
        firmware = inspect_package(fwsc, model, commit, version)
        inputs["configuration"]["firmware_version"] = version
        data["firmware_version"] = firmware["firmware_version"]
        data["firmware"] = firmware
    data["validation_inputs"] = {
        "schema": validation_inputs.SCHEMA,
        "sha256": validation_inputs.digest(validation_inputs.encoded(inputs)),
        "inputs": inputs,
    }
    record = directory / "record.json"
    record.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    checked = dev_validate.verify(repo, commit, record, fwsc)
    if checked["model"] != model:
        raise AssertionError("fixture record did not verify")
    return record


class ReleasePublishTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.repo = root / "repo"
        self.repo.mkdir()
        subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main"], cwd=self.repo)
        (self.repo / "notes.txt").write_text("fixture\n", encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(self.repo), "add", "."])
        subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(self.repo), "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t",
                               "commit", "-qm", "fixture"])

    def package(self, name, product):
        path = Path(self.tmp.name) / name
        path.write_bytes(make_pkg(product))
        return path

    def publish(self, elite, pro, elite_record, pro_record):
        page = Path(self.tmp.name) / "page"
        publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite, pro, page, push=False)
        return json.loads((page / "versions.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_shared_numeric_version_ignores_misleading_names(self):
        elite = self.package("x0x37-9.9.9_openbeta-elite.fwsc", "SMK-37 Elite_9000103")
        pro = self.package("renamed-pro.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_9000103")
        grant(self.repo, "0.1.3")
        elite_record = write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "elite", "0.1.3")
        pro_record = write_record(self.repo, "pro", pro, Path(self.tmp.name) / "pro", "0.1.3")
        bind_models(self.repo, "0.1.3", elite, pro)
        catalog = self.publish(elite, pro, elite_record, pro_record)
        self.assertEqual(catalog["latest"], "0.1.3")
        entry = catalog["versions"][0]
        self.assertEqual(entry["firmware_version"], "0.1.3")
        self.assertEqual(entry["release_display"], "0.1.3_openbeta")
        self.assertEqual(entry["models"]["elite"]["product"], "SMK-37 Elite_9000103")
        self.assertEqual(entry["models"]["pro"]["product"], "SMK-37 Pro_9000103")
        self.assertEqual(Path(entry["models"]["elite"]["pkg"]).name, "x0x37-0.1.3-elite.fwsc")
        self.assertNotIn("9.9.9", entry["models"]["elite"]["pkg"])
        self.assertNotIn("openbeta", entry["models"]["elite"]["product"])
        self.assertEqual(entry["models"]["elite"]["controller_sha256"], "ab" * 32)
        self.assertEqual(entry["models"]["pro"]["controller_sha256"], "cd" * 32)

    def test_legacy_name_does_not_invent_a_version(self):
        elite = self.package("0.1.3_openbeta.fwsc", "SMK-37 Elite_900")
        pro = self.package("0.1.3_openbeta-pro.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_900")
        catalog = self.publish(
            elite, pro,
            write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "elite-old"),
            write_record(self.repo, "pro", pro, Path(self.tmp.name) / "pro-old"))
        entry = catalog["versions"][0]
        self.assertTrue(entry["version"].startswith("nightly-"))
        self.assertNotIn("firmware_version", entry)
        self.assertNotIn("release_display", entry)
        self.assertEqual(entry["models"]["elite"]["product"], "SMK-37 Elite_900")
        self.assertEqual(entry["models"]["pro"]["product"], "SMK-37 Pro_900")

    def test_wrong_model_version_and_hash_are_refused(self):
        elite = self.package("elite.fwsc", "SMK-37 Elite_9000103")
        pro = self.package("pro.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_9000103")
        other = self.package("other.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_9000104")
        grant(self.repo, "0.1.3")
        grant(self.repo, "0.1.4")
        elite_record = write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "e", "0.1.3")
        pro_record = write_record(self.repo, "pro", pro, Path(self.tmp.name) / "p", "0.1.3")
        other_record = write_record(self.repo, "pro", other, Path(self.tmp.name) / "o", "0.1.4")
        bind_models(self.repo, "0.1.3", elite, pro)
        bind_file(self.repo / "releases" / "openbeta" / "ledger.json", "0.1.4", "pro",
                  dev_validate.digest(other), "cd" * 32, 256)
        page = Path(self.tmp.name) / "refused"
        with self.assertRaises(NightlyPublishError):
            publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, other_record, elite, other, page, push=False)
        self.assertFalse(page.exists())
        swapped = Path(self.tmp.name) / "swapped"
        with self.assertRaises(NightlyPublishError):
            publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, pro_record, pro, elite, swapped, push=False)
        self.assertFalse(swapped.exists())
        tampered = Path(self.tmp.name) / "tampered.fwsc"
        raw = bytearray(elite.read_bytes())
        raw[-1] ^= 1
        tampered.write_bytes(raw)
        hashed = Path(self.tmp.name) / "hashed"
        with self.assertRaises(NightlyPublishError):
            publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, pro_record, tampered, pro, hashed, push=False)
        self.assertFalse(hashed.exists())

    def test_unallocated_numeric_catalog_is_refused(self):
        elite = self.package("elite.fwsc", "SMK-37 Elite_9000103")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "not allocated"):
            write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "bare", "0.1.3")
        grant(self.repo, "0.1.3")
        pro = self.package("pro.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_9000103")
        elite_record = write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "e", "0.1.3")
        pro_record = write_record(self.repo, "pro", pro, Path(self.tmp.name) / "p", "0.1.3")
        ledger = self.repo / "releases" / "openbeta" / "ledger.json"
        ledger.write_text(json.dumps(empty_ledger(), indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        page = Path(self.tmp.name) / "unallocated"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(NightlyPublishError, "not allocated"):
            publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite, pro, page, push=False)
        self.assertFalse(page.exists())

    def test_same_version_collision_refuses_and_exact_rebuild_republishes(self):
        elite = self.package("elite.fwsc", "SMK-37 Elite_9000103")
        pro = self.package("pro.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_9000103")
        grant(self.repo, "0.1.3")
        elite_record = write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "e", "0.1.3")
        pro_record = write_record(self.repo, "pro", pro, Path(self.tmp.name) / "p", "0.1.3")
        bind_models(self.repo, "0.1.3", elite, pro)
        original = self.publish(elite, pro, elite_record, pro_record)
        original_sha = original["versions"][0]["models"]["elite"]["sha256"]

        def collide(name, mutate):
            history = Path(self.tmp.name) / name
            history.mkdir()
            changed = json.loads(json.dumps(original))
            mutate(changed["versions"][0])
            (history / "versions.json").write_text(json.dumps(changed), encoding="utf-8")
            page = Path(self.tmp.name) / (name + "-out")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(NightlyPublishError, "different source or package"):
                publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite, pro, page,
                                      push=False, merge=history)
            self.assertFalse(page.exists())

        collide("hash", lambda entry: entry["models"]["elite"].__setitem__("sha256", "ef" * 32))
        collide("source", lambda entry: entry.__setitem__("source_commit", "ab" * 20))
        collide("controller", lambda entry: entry["models"]["pro"].__setitem__("controller_sha256", "11" * 32))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ReleaseError, "cannot reuse"):
            bind_file(self.repo / "releases" / "openbeta" / "ledger.json", "0.1.3", "elite",
                      "ef" * 32, "ab" * 32, 128)
        again_dir = Path(self.tmp.name) / "again"
        publish_valid_nightly(self.repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite, pro, again_dir,
                              push=False, merge=Path(self.tmp.name) / "page")
        again = json.loads((again_dir / "versions.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual([item["version"] for item in again["versions"]], ["0.1.3"])
        self.assertEqual(again["versions"][0]["models"]["elite"]["sha256"], original_sha)

    def test_null_catalog_product_is_a_structured_refusal(self):
        try:
            version_of_product(None, "elite")
        except AttributeError:
            self.fail("null product raised AttributeError")
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.assertIn("text", str(exc))
        else:
            self.fail("null product was accepted")
        with self.assertRaises(NightlyPublishError):
            _embedded_version(None, "elite")
        self.assertFalse(_model_entry_ok("elite", {"product": None}))
        self.assertFalse(_version_ok({
            "version": "nightly-nullproduct",
            "label": LABEL,
            "status": "dev-checked",
            "config": "dev",
            "hardware_tested": False,
            "source_commit": "ab" * 20,
            "models": {"elite": {"product": None}, "pro": {"product": None}},
        }))
        history = Path(self.tmp.name) / "history"
        firmware = history / "firmware"
        firmware.mkdir(parents=True)
        kept_elite = firmware / "x0x37-nightly-keptkeptkee-elite.fwsc"
        kept_pro = firmware / "x0x37-nightly-keptkeptkee.fwsc"
        kept_elite.write_bytes(make_pkg("SMK-37 Elite_900"))
        kept_pro.write_bytes(make_pkg("SMK-37 Pro_900"))

        def model(path, product):
            return {
                "product": product,
                "pkg": "../firmware/" + path.name,
                "sha256": dev_validate.digest(path),
                "size": path.stat().st_size,
                "status": "dev-checked",
                "hardware_tested": False,
            }

        kept = {
            "version": "nightly-keptkeptkee",
            "label": LABEL,
            "status": "dev-checked",
            "config": "dev",
            "hardware_tested": False,
            "source_commit": "ab" * 20,
            "models": {
                "elite": model(kept_elite, "SMK-37 Elite_900"),
                "pro": model(kept_pro, "SMK-37 Pro_900"),
            },
        }
        broken = json.loads(json.dumps(kept))
        broken["version"] = "nightly-nullproduct"
        broken["models"]["elite"]["product"] = None
        broken["models"]["pro"]["product"] = None
        (history / "versions.json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"versions": [broken, kept]}), encoding="utf-8")
        elite = self.package("elite.fwsc", "SMK-37 Elite_900")
        pro = self.package("pro.fwsc", "SMK-37 Pro_900")
        page = Path(self.tmp.name) / "null-product"
        publish_valid_nightly(
            self.repo,
            write_record(self.repo, "elite", elite, Path(self.tmp.name) / "null-e"),
            write_record(self.repo, "pro", pro, Path(self.tmp.name) / "null-p"),
            elite, pro, page, push=False, merge=history)
        catalog = json.loads((page / "versions.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        versions = [item["version"] for item in catalog["versions"]]
        self.assertIn("nightly-keptkeptkee", versions)
        self.assertNotIn("nightly-nullproduct", versions)
        self.assertTrue(any(item.startswith("nightly-") and item != "nightly-keptkeptkee" for item in versions))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Release identity checks and multi-version site generation for the web installer."""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
from make_pages import installer_model, main as make_pages_main, model_key  # noqa: E402

assert installer_model("FM-1_9001000") == "FM-1"
assert installer_model("SMK-37 Pro_9001000") == "SMK-37 Pro"
assert installer_model("SMK-37 Elite_9001000") == "SMK-37 Elite"
assert installer_model("MKE-P37_9001000") == "MKE-P37"
assert model_key("SMK-37 Elite_9001000") == "elite"
for invalid in ("FM-1_900", "SMK-37 Pro_900", "SMK-37+VA_9001000", "other_9001000"):
    try:
        installer_model(invalid)
    except SystemExit:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"accepted unsupported identity {invalid}")

html = (ROOT / "web/x0x_installer.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert 'id="stock"' in html and 'id="version"' in html and 'id="models"' in html

assert "installKeepingSlots" in html or "/*LIB*/" in html
assert 'id="stockdrop"' in html

# Synthetic packages (identity + FELUCCA-LOADER-1)
BLOCKS, BLK, KEEP = 20, 0x30, 0x2F


def make_pkg(product: str, path: Path):
    raw = bytearray(0x2000)
    for i, ch in enumerate(product[:20]):
        raw[i * BLK + KEEP] = (ord(ch) + i + 1) & 0xFF
    for i in range(len(product), BLOCKS):
        raw[i * BLK + KEEP] = 0x7D
    raw[0x400:0x400 + 15] = b"FELUCCA-LOADER-1"
    path.write_bytes(raw)


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    td = Path(td)
    fixtures = td / "fw"
    fixtures.mkdir()
    make_pkg("SMK-37 Pro_9002000", fixtures / "pro-0.2.fwsc")
    make_pkg("SMK-37 Elite_9002000", fixtures / "elite-0.2.fwsc")
    make_pkg("MKE-P37_9002000", fixtures / "mke-0.2.fwsc")
    make_pkg("SMK-37 Pro_9001000", fixtures / "pro-0.1.fwsc")
    make_pkg("SMK-37 Elite_9001000", fixtures / "elite-0.1.fwsc")

    out1 = td / "site1"

    cat1 = json.loads((out1 / "versions.json").read_text())
    assert cat1["latest"] == "0.1"
    assert set(cat1["versions"][0]["models"]) == {"pro", "elite"}
    assert (out1 / "firmware" / "x0x37-0.1.fwsc").is_file()
    assert (out1 / "firmware" / "x0x37-0.1-elite.fwsc").is_file()
    assert (out1 / "install" / "index.html").is_file()
    assert (out1 / "breaks" / "index.html").is_file()
    inst = (out1 / "install" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "SMK-37 Pro_9001000" in inst
    assert "/*CATALOG*/" not in inst and "/*LIB*/" not in inst
    assert "productOf" in inst and "Updater" in inst

    out2 = td / "site2"
    make_pages_main([
        "--version", "0.2", "--out", str(out2),
        "--pro", str(fixtures / "pro-0.2.fwsc"),
        "--elite", str(fixtures / "elite-0.2.fwsc"),
        "--mke", str(fixtures / "mke-0.2.fwsc"),
        "--merge", str(out1),
    ])
    cat2 = json.loads((out2 / "versions.json").read_text())
    assert cat2["latest"] == "0.2"
    assert {v["version"] for v in cat2["versions"]} == {"0.1", "0.2"}
    assert (out2 / "firmware" / "x0x37-0.1.fwsc").is_file(), "merge must keep older firmware"
    assert (out2 / "firmware" / "x0x37-0.2-mke.fwsc").is_file()
    assert set(next(v for v in cat2["versions"] if v["version"] == "0.2")["models"]) == {"pro", "elite", "mke"}

    # Legacy single-package argv
    out3 = td / "site3"
    make_pkg("FM-1_9001000", fixtures / "fm1.fwsc")
    make_pages_main([str(fixtures / "fm1.fwsc"), "1.0", str(out3)])
    cat3 = json.loads((out3 / "versions.json").read_text())
    assert cat3["latest"] == "1.0"
    assert "fm1" in cat3["versions"][0]["models"]
    assert (out3 / "firmware" / "x0x-1.0.fwsc").is_file()
    assert "X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro" in (out2 / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    out_shell = td / "shell"
    make_pages_main(["--shell", "--out", str(out_shell)])
    assert (out_shell / "install" / "index.html").is_file()
    assert (out_shell / "breaks" / "index.html").is_file()
    assert (out_shell / "projects" / "index.html").is_file()
    assert (out_shell / "projects" / "x0x_projects.js").is_file()
    shell_cat = json.loads((out_shell / "versions.json").read_text())
    assert shell_cat["versions"] == []
    shell_inst = (out_shell / "install" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "noversion" in shell_inst and "stockdrop" in shell_inst

/* SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0
 * Copyright (C) 2026 M. Geisler (genkigenki/makkuro)
 *
 * pi32v2 helpers for the controller image. The register use follows the code that the JieLi
 * clang makes for the X0X app: r0-r3 carry the arguments and the result, r4-r15 belong to the
 * caller (a function saves them with [--sp] = {rets, r15-r4} and returns with
 * {pc, r15-r4} = [sp++]). */
	.section .text.ctl_asm,"ax",@progbits
	.balign 4

/* void ctl_asm_ctx_switch(void **from_sp, void *const *to_sp)
 * Save r4-r15 and the return address on this stack, keep sp in *from_sp, take sp from *to_sp and
 * return into the other context. A new context (ctl_port_ctx_init) has 13 words that all hold its
 * entry address, so the same return starts it. */
	.globl ctl_asm_ctx_switch
ctl_asm_ctx_switch:
	[--sp] = {rets, r15-r4}
	r2 = sp
	[r0 + 0] = r2
	r2 = [r1 + 0]
	sp = r2
	{pc, r15-r4} = [sp++]

/* u32 ctl_asm_stack_call(u32 (*fn)(u32), u32 arg, void *stack_top)
 * Call fn(arg) on another stack and come back to this one. */
	.globl ctl_asm_stack_call
ctl_asm_stack_call:
	[--sp] = {rets, r5, r4}
	r4 = sp
	r5 = r0
	r0 = r1
	sp = r2
	call r5
	sp = r4
	{pc, r5, r4} = [sp++]

/* u32 ctl_asm_sp(void): the stack pointer now (in an interrupt: the interrupt stack) */
	.globl ctl_asm_sp
ctl_asm_sp:
	r0 = sp
	rts
